items.q:
Write an email of 100-120 words to a friend asking them to come with you abroad this summer to do an English course. The following notes will be useful:
- Suggest the month when you'd like to go and how long you'd like to go for.
- Describe the choice of locations.
- Suggest the location you'd prefer. Give reasons for your preference.
- Say you are open to suggestions about location.
- Suggest the type of accommodation you would prefer. Give reasons.
- Talk about the prices. Say that you know it will be expensive, but you think it will be worth it.
items.answer:
English Course Abroad!
Hi Zaid,
I'm planning to do a four-week English course abroad this July and would love for you to come with me! We could choose between a lively city like London full of shops, restaurants, and things to do or a peaceful countryside spot where we could relax and get fit. I'd prefer the city for the energy and activities, but I'm open to your ideas! I think staying with an English family would help us practice English more in the evenings, though a hostel could be fun too. I know it'll be expensive,  
Let me know what you think!   
Best wishes  
Ahmed

sections.title: الكتابة 72/H – اكتب 100-120 كلمة حول فوائد دراسة اللغة انكليزية في بريطانيا

items.q: Write a 100 to 120 words on the advantages of studying English in Britain. These notes may help you: you can hear people speaking English all day, in many different situations; lots of opportunities to practise speaking, especially if staying with a British family; watch TV and films in English and listen to radio; read English newspapers, advertisements, notices; observe British way of life; possibly stay with British family.
items.answer:
Studying English in Britain
Studying English in Britain has many benefits. You hear English every day, in shops, and in parks so you get better fast. If you stay with a British family, you can practise speaking English at home. You can also watch TV, films, and listen to the radio in English, which helps you understand real conversations. Reading newspapers, signs, teaches you new words and shows you how people live. All this makes learning English easier, more fun, and more useful than studying it in your own country. Being in Britain gives you the best chance to become fluent and confident in English.
